# Vacancy research: 800 Center St, Oakland

- APN: 004-0067-016-00 (user-supplied APN 004 006701600)
- Verdict: likely_vacant
- Confidence: 0.88
- Rationale: Oakland's FY 2025-26 roll assigns APN 004-0067-016-00 use code 3000, which Alameda County defines as vacant commercial land; assessor codes can be outdated. County and City records also describe it as a vacant lot in 1997 and 2007 and the three-parcel site as vacant in 2021. This supports vacant land, not exact current condition. Start date and uninterrupted duration are unknown.
- Vacancy start: unknown; documented vacant by 1997-04-18.
- Duration: unknown. Vacant-lot observations in 1997 and 2021 are 24 years apart; they do not establish uninterrupted vacancy or current physical condition.

## Evidence

1. [Alameda County Environmental Health Services letter (1997-04-18)](https://dehpra.acgov.org/Lopinfo/ReadFile?record=RO0000454%5CDIR_L.pdf): calls 800 Center St a vacant lot and discusses proposed housing.
2. [Oakland City Planning Commission agenda (2007-06-06)](https://oaklandca.s3.us-west-1.amazonaws.com/oakca1/groups/ceda/documents/webcontent/oak035590.pdf): identifies APNs 004-0067-015-00, -016-00, and -017-00 and calls the location a vacant lot; the development proposal is not proof it was built.
3. [LoopNet listing](https://www.loopnet.com/Listing/800-Center-St-Oakland-CA/20003911/): listed the multi-parcel 800 Center site as land for sale on 2020-06-22 and names APN 004-0067-016-00.
4. [Alameda County cleanup fact sheet (2021-09-15)](https://deh.acgov.org/landwater-assets/docs/public-notices/RO0000454_FACT_SHT_2021-09-15.pdf): says all three parcels at 800 Center Street were vacant lots; cleanup was scheduled for late September 2021.
5. [City of Oakland FY 2025-26 Preliminary Assessment Roll](https://oakland.legistar.com/View.ashx?G=undefined&GUID=61973545-CCA6-4FEA-A0DA-F79F7C713734&ID=14019286&M=F): lists this APN with use code 3000. [Alameda County's use-code list](https://propinfo.acgov.org/UseCodeList/) defines code 3000 as vacant commercial land, possibly with miscellaneous improvements.
6. [Alameda County Assessor use-code disclaimer](https://www.acassessor.org/use-codes/): says codes are intended for appraisal purposes and property characteristics are not continuously updated.

The parcel was historically a service station site; station closure or remediation dates do not by themselves establish when the current vacant-lot condition began. The evidence supports likely vacant land, not a specific vacancy start date or continuous vacancy duration.
